questions.q: Which of the following is the most primary importance of agriculture to mankind?
questions.explain: The primary and most fundamental importance of agriculture is the provision of food to ensure human survival.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Agriculture provides raw materials for the textile industry primarily through the production of ________.
questions.explain: Cotton is an agricultural crop widely used in the textile industry to manufacture clothes and fabrics.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which agricultural practice is mainly concerned with the rearing of grazing animals such as cattle, sheep, and goats?
questions.explain: Pastoral farming is a system of agriculture focused entirely on raising livestock, especially grazing animals like cattle, sheep, and goats.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Arable farming is an agricultural practice that focuses strictly on the ________.
questions.explain: Arable farming involves the growing of crops on land. It does not involve the rearing of animals.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: In agriculture, apiculture refers to the commercial rearing of ________.
questions.explain: Apiculture is the technical term for bee farming, which is practiced mainly for the production of honey and wax.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The rearing of snails for human consumption and other uses is termed ________.
questions.explain: Snailry (also known as heliciculture) is the process of farming or raising land snails specifically for human consumption.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT considered a direct importance of agriculture to the Nigerian economy?
questions.explain: Depletion of the ozone layer is an environmental problem, not an importance or benefit of agriculture.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: An agricultural system in which a farmer grows crops and rears animals simultaneously on the same piece of land is known as ________.
questions.explain: Mixed farming is the practice of combining crop cultivation with livestock rearing on the same farm.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The rearing of fish in ponds, rivers, or specially designed tanks is a form of agriculture called ________.
questions.explain: Aquaculture, specifically pisciculture, is the practice of rearing fish in enclosed water bodies for commercial or domestic purposes.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is an agricultural product used primarily as a source of clothing material?
questions.explain: Wool, obtained from sheep, is processed into yarns and used for making clothing, specifically warm garments.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which form of agricultural activity specifically involves the cultivation of fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants?
questions.explain: Horticulture is the branch of agriculture that deals with the art, science, and business of growing garden plants, which includes fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Nomadic farming, where farmers move with their herds in search of pasture and water, is a traditional form of ________.
questions.explain: Nomadic farming is a subset of pastoral farming because it exclusively involves the management and rearing of livestock (grazing animals) while moving them across different lands.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Agriculture serves the industrial sector mostly by providing ________.
questions.explain: Many industries depend on agriculture for raw materials, such as rubber for tyre manufacturing, cocoa for chocolate, and cotton for textiles.
